newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Capricorn jumps on Roundtop results.
newsitem.headline: Capricorn jumps on Roundtop results.

text.p: Shares in minerals explorer Capricorn Resources Australia NL jumped nearly 18 percent to a record high 43.5 cents on Friday after the release of drilling results from its Roundtop nickel joint venture in Western Australia.
The new results from hole RTD50 at the Emily Ann project included two separate intersections of 5.1 metres at 7.41 percent nickel and 3.05 metres at 2.7 percent nickel.
Capricorn said the results confirm earlier eatimates in its third quarter activities report on April 30 of 13.51 metres at an estimated three percent nickel.
"It's more of the same really but the more of those results that come out, the more it suggests it could be a viable project," said a resources analyst at a Sydney-based brokerage firm.
The Roundtop joint venture is held 37.5 percent by Forrestania Gold, 37.5 percent by South Africa's Gencor Ltd and 25 percent by Capricorn.
Capricorn shares closed 6.5 cents higher at 43.5 cents on turnover of 5.7 million shares.
